# Stand Firm in the Storm
## Scripture
"Be watchful, stand firm in the faith, act like men, be strong." – 1 Corinthians 16:13
## Reflection
Paul's charge to the Corinthians is a battle cry for every man who claims the name of Christ. Notice the progression: be watchful, stand firm, act like men, be strong. This isn't passive Christianity. It's a call to vigilance and courage in a world that constantly pressures us to compromise. The phrase "act like men" carries the weight of maturity—not machismo, but the settled resolve of a man who knows what he believes and refuses to be moved. Strength here isn't about your bench press; it's about spiritual backbone. It's the discipline to show up when you're tired, to lead when it's costly, and to hold the line when no one's watching. Where is God calling you to stand firm today? Your marriage? Your integrity at work? Your thought life? The storms will come. The question is whether you'll be found standing when they pass. Root yourself in the Word, surround yourself with brothers who sharpen you, and refuse to drift.
## Daily Challenge
Do 30 seconds of wall sit while reciting 1 Corinthians 16:13 aloud—then text one brother and ask him to hold you accountable this week.
